title: Design System: 爆点实验室图片创作

display.purpose: Compact page names; never a giant promotional headline.

headline.purpose: Concept name inside the proof canvas overlay.

title.purpose: Numbered panel headings and key module titles.

body.purpose: Editable task inputs and primary explanatory copy.

label.purpose: Field names, states, ratios and secondary actions.

shadows.name: panel-float
shadows.purpose: Shared low lift for the job ticket, proof canvas and contact sheet panels.

shadows.name: proof-sheet
shadows.purpose: Makes the output frame read as a physical proof sheet on the dark table.

shadows.name: menu-lift
shadows.purpose: Temporary lift for the industry picker menu.

shadows.name: primary-action
shadows.purpose: Restrained ink-colored lift under the generate button.

shadows.name: mobile-launch
shadows.purpose: Separates the fixed mobile generation bar from scrolling content.

motion.name: proof-in
motion.purpose: Subtle fade and 1.2% scale correction when the proof image changes.

motion.name: disclosure
motion.purpose: Rotates disclosure arrows when supplemental details open.

motion.name: primary-hover
motion.purpose: A single-pixel lift on the generate action; active state returns to rest.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes proof image animation and disclosure transitions when reduced motion is preferred.

components.name: Generate Button
components.description: The sole high-emphasis action that launches three image generations.
components.css: .ds-generate { width: 100%; min-height: 54px; padding: 0 18px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; background: #ff4d8d; color: #190b11; cursor: pointer; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 900; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(255,77,141,.18); transition: background .2s ease, transform .2s ease; } .ds-generate svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; color: #f4c95d; } .ds-generate:hover { background: #ff659e; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-generate:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-generate:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #59d9e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Download Button
components.description: A quiet bordered action shown only when a generated result is available.
components.css: .ds-download { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; border: 1px solid #434752; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #f6f3ef; cursor: pointer; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-download svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; } .ds-download:hover { border-color: #59d9e8; } .ds-download:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #59d9e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Job Ticket Field
components.description: The standard labeled text area for task facts and campaign inputs.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; color: #9a9eaa; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-field span { display: block; margin-bottom: 7px; } .ds-field textarea { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 72px; padding: 11px 12px; resize: vertical; border: 1px solid #30343d; border-radius: 10px; outline: 0; background: #121419; color: #f6f3ef; font: 400 13px/1.55 "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field textarea:hover { border-color: #434752; } .ds-field textarea:focus { border-color: #59d9e8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(89,217,232,.09); } .ds-field textarea:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #59d9e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Format Segmented Control
components.description: A compact ratio switcher that keeps production formats visible above the proof canvas.
components.css: .ds-formats { padding: 3px; display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; border-radius: 10px; background: #111318; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-formats button { min-width: 49px; height: 31px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #90959f; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; } .ds-formats button:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-formats button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #2b2d34; color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px #ff4d8d; } .ds-formats button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #59d9e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Creative Direction Card
components.description: A compact visual strategy choice with a thumbnail, sequence number and reaction cue.
components.css: .ds-direction { min-width: 220px; min-height: 64px; padding: 6px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 48px minmax(0,1fr); align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid #30343d; border-radius: 10px; background: #121419; color: #9a9eaa; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-direction-art { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 7px; background: linear-gradient(145deg,#3b2731,#ff4d8d 48%,#17191e 49%); } .ds-direction-copy { min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-direction small { color: #ff4d8d; font-size: 10px; } .ds-direction b { color: #f6f3ef; font-size: 11px; } .ds-direction i { overflow: hidden; color: #90959f; font-size: 10px; font-style: normal; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-direction:hover { border-color: #434752; } .ds-direction[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: #754156; background: #251e23; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px #ff4d8d; } .ds-direction:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #59d9e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Contact Sheet Result
components.description: A numbered result row used both before generation as a direction preview and after generation as a selectable output.
components.css: .ds-result { width: 100%; min-height: 112px; padding: 7px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px 106px minmax(0,1fr) 18px; align-items: center; gap: 9px; border: 1px solid #30343d; border-radius: 11px; background: #121419; color: #9a9eaa; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-result-number { color: #90959f; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; } .ds-result-art { width: 106px; height: 94px; border-radius: 7px; background: linear-gradient(155deg,#20232a,#ff4d8d 48%,#101114 49%); } .ds-result-copy { min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 7px; } .ds-result-copy b { color: #f6f3ef; font-size: 13px; } .ds-result-copy small { color: #90959f; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-result-check { color: #ff4d8d; font-weight: 900; } .ds-result:hover { border-color: #434752; } .ds-result[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: #754156; background: #251e23; } .ds-result:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #59d9e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Proof Canvas
components.description: The signature print-proof stage with center axes, registration marks and a low-radius output sheet.
components.html: 01 / HERO产品定场第一眼记住主推服务
components.css: .ds-stage { position: relative; width: min(100%,420px); height: 410px; padding: 18px; display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #262930; border-radius: 13px; background: linear-gradient(90deg,transparent calc(50% - .5px),#262930 50%,transparent calc(50% + .5px)),linear-gradient(transparent calc(50% - .5px),#262930 50%,transparent calc(50% + .5px)),#0d0f13; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-register { position: absolute; z-index: 2; width: 10px; height: 10px; border: 1px solid #59d9e8; border-radius: 50%; opacity: .7; } .ds-register::before,.ds-register::after { content: ""; position: absolute; background: #59d9e8; } .ds-register::before { left: 4px; top: -4px; width: 1px; height: 16px; } .ds-register::after { top: 4px; left: -4px; width: 16px; height: 1px; } .ds-register-a { top: 12px; left: 12px; } .ds-register-b { right: 12px; bottom: 12px; border-color: #ff4d8d; } .ds-register-b::before,.ds-register-b::after { background: #ff4d8d; } .ds-sheet { position: relative; z-index: 1; height: 100%; aspect-ratio: 3/4; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 4px; background: #1c1f25; box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.46),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.08); } .ds-sheet-art { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 68% 28%,#f4c95d 0 13%,#ff4d8d 14% 31%,#20232a 55%,#101114); } .ds-sheet-copy { position: absolute; left: 7%; right: 7%; bottom: 6%; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 9px; background: rgba(9,10,13,.82); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); color: #f6f3ef; } .ds-sheet-copy small,.ds-sheet-copy b,.ds-sheet-copy span { display: block; } .ds-sheet-copy small { color: #59d9e8; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-sheet-copy b { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -.04em; } .ds-sheet-copy span { margin-top: 6px; color: #d5d6da; font-size: 11px; }

components.name: Workbench Navigation
components.description: The graphite shared shell navigation with one quiet magenta active state.
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 188px; padding: 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; background: #141519; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav button { width: 100%; height: 45px; padding: 0 13px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #989ca6; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 20px; color: #747985; text-align: center; } .ds-nav button:hover { background: #202228; color: #f6f3ef; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-active { background: #29242b; color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #4b3540; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-active .ds-nav-icon { color: #ff6aa0; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #59d9e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.northStar: The Print Proofing Table / 印刷打样台
narrative.overview:
图片创作世界把营销任务呈现成一张摆在石墨工作台上的印刷工单：信息具体、层级安静、每一步都可以立即操作。柔和的深色表面承担长时间工作，套准标记与克制的品红、电子青、信号黄只用来说明选择、焦点、成本和生产状态。

体验遵循“工单 → 打样画布 → 联系表 → 生成”的阅读顺序。品牌可以有冲击力，但操作密度、可见状态和真实投放约束始终优先；共享工作台外壳也延续同一石墨材质与克制状态语言，不把旧页面的视觉习惯当作这一新世界的规则。
keyCharacteristics: 石墨纸张般的深色底与柔和分层表面
先任务、后画布、再成品联系表的清晰操作层级
品红表示主选择与生成，电子青表示焦点与校准，信号黄表示成本或提醒
标准矩形控件、轻圆角和印刷套准标记形成可识别的工作台世界
桌面端高密度并排工作，窄屏按任务顺序纵向展开

rules.name: The Three-Ink Rule
rules.body: 品红只表示主选择或生成，电子青只表示焦点与校准，信号黄只表示成本或生产提示；不要互换语义。

rules.name: The Ink Is Rare Rule
rules.body: 任一打样墨色都不铺满面板，也不叠加发光；大面积始终由石墨中性色承担。

rules.name: The Job-Ticket Type Rule
rules.body: 字号服务于扫描和操作层级；页面标题保持克制，禁止用巨型展示字制造戏剧性。

rules.name: The Workflow Order Rule
rules.body: 响应式重排可以改变列数，但不能改变“工单 → 打样画布 → 联系表 → 生成”的任务顺序。

rules.name: The Structural Shadow Rule
rules.body: 阴影只说明真实层级或操作状态；静态装饰和信息卡不凭空漂浮。

rules.name: The Proof Sheet Rule
rules.body: 大容器可以柔和，成品画幅必须更像纸张；用较小圆角区分“工具”与“作品”。

dos: Do 保持工单、打样画布、联系表和生成操作的阅读顺序，即使布局在窄屏重排。
Do 用石墨色调、完整 1px 边框和轻阴影建立层级，让打样墨色只承担明确状态。
Do 保留可见的电子青键盘焦点、语义化选择状态和生成状态播报。
Do 让共享侧栏和内容表面使用同一石墨材质，并在 820px 以下转换为紧凑顶部导航。
Do 把套准标记限制在打样画布，把小圆角的成品纸与较柔和的工具面板区分开。
donts: Don't 使用游戏控制台式 HUD、霓虹描边或发光堆叠。
Don't 裁切面板边缘、制造异形缺角，或把套准装饰复制到普通控件。
Don't 用巨型展示字压过任务信息、主画布或唯一主操作。
Don't 添加与任务无关的遥测数字、状态灯或装饰性技术读数。
Don't 把项目中无关的旧页面 CSS、绿色纸张世界或高饱和旧 Image Lab 规则视为本系统规范。
